title: Enhancing Healthcare LLM Trust with Atypical Presentations Recalibration

live_model.evidence: We use a variety of commercial LLMs that includes GPT-3.5-turbo (OpenAI, 2023), GPT-4-turbo (OpenAI, 2024), Claude3-sonnet and Gemini 1.0 Pro (Section 4, Models); Table 2 block 'gpt-4-turbo'

prompt.location: Appendix B, Table 3 (complete prompts for Atypical Scenario and Atypical Presentations); Table 1 (vanilla prompt)
prompt.note: Vanilla prompt appears only as a one-line illustration in Table 1; the two recalibration prompts are complete.

claim.location: Table 2, block gpt-4-turbo, row 'Atypical presentations', MedQA Acc (ECE 0.114 in the same row)

data.source: MedQA dev (n=1272), MedMCQA dev (n=2816), PubMedQA (n=500); public

notes: arXiv Sept 2024, no preview string. Headline metric is ECE (0.114 vs vanilla 0.133) parsed from verbalized confidence; accuracy is the robust check. Decoding parameters not stated. Code: github.com/jeremy-qin/.
